name: Troskovice
text: Troskovice (German: Troskowitz) is a municipality and village in Semily District in the Liberec Region of the Czech Republic. It has about 80 inhabitants.

depictions.name: Troskowitz
depictions.text: Troskowitz is a village in, located at the foot of the Trosky Castle roughly in the centre of the Trosky region. As the largest settlement in the region after Trosky itself, Troskowitz functions as the administrative centre for the common folk and the seat of the region's bailiff, where the Rathaus is located.
